cards.title: Hidden Power
cards.instruction: Act publicly modest while making choices as though you control the outcome.

cards.title: How Much Do You Know?
cards.instruction: Probe for what others know while revealing as little as possible.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm just filling in the lost-key book. What did the manager actually say? I'll decide whether to call maintenance once that's clear.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They might be in the drain. You locked up, didn't you?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Is she asking everyone that, or just me? No point having the drain opened on a guess.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Just you. Someone saw you outside.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Did they see what I was doing, or only where I was? I'll leave maintenance out of it until we have something more useful than 'outside'.

reason: Make S06 act through a specific modest role and practical decisions about access, timing, presentation or resources. Preserve the original Drive response chain where sound; remove reviewer-facing outcome language.
